INTERNAL CONTROL

System. The Internal Audit section of the Parent Company reviews the effectiveness of
the Company’s internal controls in order to ensure reasonable assurance that assets
are safeguarded, and all transactions are properly authorized and recorded. The Board
reviews the recommendations of External Auditors and takes appropriate action to
maintain an adequate internal control system.
